name: Usun Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Usun Technology Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, designs, produces, and maintains automation equipment in Taiwan, China, and internationally. The company offers advanced process equipment system, including OCA laminator, 3D automatic laminator, OCR laminator, G10 glass dense unpack, slit coater, thin film coating system, vacuum chamber dryer, and demura+gamma turing machine; non-standard customized automated equipment, such as automatic lens assembly machine CCM, galvanometer system, mask machine, sole edging machine, double-sided automatic laminating machine, automatic loading and unloading machine, lithium battery equipment, and laser marking.
